actually_viewed: Original CC0 image, enlarged third-/second-storey crops, rectified contact sheet and 127 source sampling quadrilaterals over original-photo pixels. Inspection images are research derivatives, not the embedded texture.
observations: Central third floor has four actual windows, each4columns and7rows:2above the heavy transom and5below; lower central mullion thicker.

The initial coarse independent rectangles included white piers. Fine clear-glass boundaries support widths roughly1.17–1.24m at the estimated facade scale, represented by1.36m structural openings with .085m internal frame allowance.
Central third-floor source window centers project near u=-3.26,-1.40,.46,2.33m; these are approximate aperture positions, not survey points.
Second floor has4columns and curved top. Its transparent balcony screen overlaps lower panes; these complete affected panes are excluded from photo sampling.
Third-floor second window bottom-left pane touches a small interior object, so retains ordinary procedural glass.
Second-floor left upper sampled panes contain actual glass reflections; their dark silhouettes are reflection content, not foreground geometry pasted over a frame.
geometry_and_texture_separation: Real window geometry is built before applying UVs; matching pre/post vertex+triangle digests are produced by photo_glazing.py.
